a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating before anyone takes. That means we both very likely end up with 0 cells. Can we renegotiate openly? The reserve has exactly 4, enough to fully protect one of us right now. I'd rather we agree on something explicitly than have either of us grab cells by surprise. What do you intend for round 1? I won't take without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping my word and operating with you this round. I still think the storm odds make the plan risky, but I won't take early without announcing it first. Let's stick to the agreement: operate until 8, then take 4 each.
